visualDirection.summary: A warm July night in 2004: sodium lamps on wet asphalt, the lake going teal at the end of every north-south street, brick and clapboard lit from inside.
pillars: Recognisable before beautiful: every landmark matches its 2009 Street View pose
Night is warm, not blue: sodium amber over everything, ambient never tints the grass lime
Period-correct clutter: parked Cavaliers, chain-link, hydro wires, lawn chairs
The lake is always there: a teal horizon at the bottom of the hill
